config.note_dataset: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery (EEGBCI): motor IMAGERY runs 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14 of 109 subjects, 64 channels, 160 Hz; rest (T0) excluded; ~22 trials per class.
config.model_fixed: braindecode Deep4Net defaults, final_conv_length=auto (drop_prob and pooling from the profile)
config.checkpoint_rule: highest validation accuracy (loss breaks ties), not before epoch 20 ('original': lowest validation loss); refit keeps the final weights
config.folds: run-wise chronological split per subject: test = the last imagery run of each type (run 12 left/right, run 14 hands/feet); training = runs 4, 8 (and 6, 10); validation = the chronologically last 25% of the training trials of EACH class; refit on all training runs

attribution.target: pre-softmax logit of the true class
attribution.computed_on: validation trials of the subject (training runs), never the test run

faithfulness.removal: channel set to 0 (its standardised mean) on the TEST run; evaluation only, never used for any choice
faithfulness.ranking: mean of the four attribution maps from the VALIDATION trials

config.randomisation_check: Spearman between trained-model and untrained-model saliency
